The '''Rusty Pan''' is a starter [[Pans|Pan]] obtained for free when joining ''Prospecting!''

== Overview ==
A rusty pan for gold panning. Not great, but it gets you started.

The Rusty Pan is the most basic panning tool and serves as an introduction for new players. It features low {{Stat|Luck}}, modest {{Stat|Capacity (Pans)}}, and minimal {{Stat|Strength}} with a slower {{Stat|Speed}} compared to later pans. It’s reliable enough to begin collecting minerals until you can afford upgrades.

== Stats ==
* {{Stat|Luck}}: '''1'''
* {{Stat|Capacity (Pans)}}: '''5'''
* {{Stat|Shake Strength}}: '''0.2'''
* {{Stat|Shake Speed}}: '''0.8'''

== Obtainment ==
* Given to the player upon joining the game.

== Trivia ==
* Functions as the entry-level pan, analogous to other starter tools.
